_comment: Client-side settings for Simple Voice Distance (voice_hud)
_comment_hudOffsetX: Horizontal offset of the voice HUD icon (pixels)
_comment_hudOffsetY: Vertical offset of the voice HUD icon (pixels)
_comment_modeTagOffsetX: Horizontal offset of the voice mode tag (pixels)
_comment_modeTagOffsetY: Vertical offset of the voice mode tag (pixels)
_comment_showVoiceModeTag: Show voice mode tag (e.g. [WHISPER], [NORMAL], [CALL], [SHOUT]) next to player names
_comment_showWelcomeMessage: Show welcome message on client login
_comment_showChatPrefix: Show current voice range in chat message suffix
